headline: Every arcade title now files a feedback report — and a law keeps it that way
lede: The seedpin rollout closed its coverage phase: Ultima I–V, King's Quest and Zork file honest seedless reports, and a new total-coverage law means no game can ship without one.

notes.text: SEEDPIN b21+b22 merged (PR #1550): DosShell — the shared js-dos mount for Ultima I–V — plus KingsQuest and Zork now report {tick, score, done} while the emulator runs. Binary ROMs have no seed to pin, so the zeros are honest unknowns, never fakes.

SEEDPIN b23 merged (PR #1552): total-coverage law — all 83 game directories must file a report, with a shrink-only budget for the 13 legacy titles that report in shapes the strict parsers can't see. Mutant-proven: silencing any title turns the suite red.
Seedless floor 28, pin floor 55, coverage 83/83. feedbackcheck grew four honest laws and two ratchets; each came with its own kill-proof.
Next batches normalize the 13 legacy report shapes (multiplayer ones carefully — online seed authority stays untouched). #1473 remains open as the rollout umbrella.

look.text: Zork on the ifvms VM — same reporting pattern, no canvas needed
